title: Mobile first screen — two figures, one direction (6H-a)
summary: Approved by the founder on 14 September 2026. Portrait first screen: the giant walks and points, the founder on its shoulder, statement in the sky, question in the grass.
identity: On the shoulder: one weathered granite giant, golden dawn country, a waking city; the founder stands on the giant's shoulder and points, the giant goes where they point.
Full-bleed photographic art under live text; quiet high-contrast serif statements, clean sans small lines, warm cream text with a soft shadow for legibility.
The tiny founder on the shoulder is the focal point at every width; no text or panel crosses the founder or the giant's face.
Voice Covenant: enable, never diminish; no invented metrics, endorsements or awards.
